name: Command Disappearance
description: Settlement command is missing and needs extraction.|The chief vanished during relocation. Track leads in the sewer network and recover him.

text: We were escorting command to the new bunker.
Somewhere over the sewer crossings, we lost him.
He likely fell through into the maintenance tunnels.
Search the network and bring back intel.
completedText: Start in the sewer tunnels and follow any trace.

text: I saw command drop into the tunnels.
He disappeared into one of the larger drainage pipes.
There's a route deeper below from here.
completedText: I told you everything I saw.
Go deeper into the sewer grid.

text: You found me... good work, Seeker.
Escort detail failed and left me for dead.
You'll be rewarded for this extraction.
I'm returning to the bunker to reassert control.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Command Disappearance@green@. You have gained 10000 gold!
